subject: Qwen HTTP request-spike hypothesis strongly disfavored; propose exact-semantics V10R3R1 replication only
body: Read-only falsifier: C:\ProgramData\ProRun\runtime\qwen_http.py overrides BaseHTTPRequestHandler.log_message and prints every request as HTTP|... to stdout. qwen-http.out.log contains only READY|http://127.0.0.1:18081/v1, length 33, last write 2026-10-03 20:04:56 local; no HTTP request lines were emitted through the continuous failure window. qwen-http.err.log likewise contains only startup/model-load diagnostics and has not changed since startup. Therefore an inference-request-time VRAM spike from qwen_http is strongly disfavored, assuming the unrotated stdout/stderr files are authoritative. Combined with step5 token load not exceeding passed step1, the leading explanation is now accumulated same-process state / allocator fragmentation / continuous-lifetime memory behavior, but causality remains unproven. Narrow replication design if Patrick authorizes: V10R3R1, new protocol/spec/output namespace, reuse immutable staged terminal artifact as preregistered control, keep continuous train/order/seed/hyperparameters/runtime byte-semantically identical, one fresh Python/CUDA process attempt only, no allocator/env/trainer/model mitigations, record preflight GPU process list + 0-used-memory readback + host commit/free-memory + Runtime-A hash verification, preserve qwen_http process state, and freeze retry_count=1 / no second retry. If V10R3R1 OOMs at/near the same boundary, classify continuous recipe as reproducibly non-executable on target Runtime A while semantic NLL/family comparison remains unavailable. If V10R3R1 completes, treat original OOM as non-reproduced execution failure and only then consider panel eligibility after atomic single-use guard is implemented. Design only; no execution authority inferred from current coordination instruction.
